Name: Anna Lollipop - Custom NPC UPDATE 3.0.0
Author: AnnasCreator
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1793419425-1396675130.png[/img]

[/center]
[center][left][b][size=5]There's a foreign girl in town![/size][/b][/left]
[left]Anna showed up in Pelican Town out of the blue. She had nothing but hope that she’d find somewhere better. She came from the Gallia Continents, a place far, far away with its own language, its own culture, and a level of corruption that eventually pushed her to leave. She spent everything she had on a plane ticket and bus fare just to get here. Shortly after, she managed to befriend Haley and stay with her. Until her own place is fully built, that’s where you’ll find her. Around town, she’s the one being dramatic, complaining constantly about the summer heat, and standing outside in the snow during winter having the time of her life. She’s warm, chaotic and lollipop-obsessed, but still having a hard time adjusting to her new way of life.[/left]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/B61cDNQ2/Anna-Features.png[/img]

[left][b][size=4]Anna is still under development, but at this stage she’s mostly complete. Anna’s key features are:[/size][/b][/left]

[left][list]
[*]A full 5 event story arc through her heart events[/*]
[*]Full marriage content, with her own spouse room, patio and portrait furniture[/*]
[*]Marriage dialogue that changes with the season, the weather, and your relationship[/*]
[*]Her own custom home in town starting year 2[/*]
[*]Visits the Ginger Island resort in her own beach outfit[/*]
[*]Takes part in every festival, from the Flower Dance to the Winter Star gift exchange[/*]
[*]Her own taste in films and snacks at the movie theater[/*]
[*]Reacts to the valley changing, from the Community Center to Willy’s boat[/*]
[*]Gallian spread throughout her dialogue (French)[/*]
[*]A warm winter outfit[/*]
[*]3 optional alternative styles[/*]
[*]and so much more![/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][/left]

[b][size=6]UPDATE
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1793421288-734100338.png[/img][/size]

[/b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1793421365-991984088.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1793421358-948212267.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/7hxKPrL7/Anna-File-House.png[/img][/center]
[b][size=4]UPDATE 3.0.0[/size][/b]
Anna has been redrawn from scratch. New portrait, new sprites, new winter outfit, new everything, all drawn by me.
Anna goes to Ginger Island! Once the resort is open she’ll show up and change into her own beach outfit, then spend the day complaining about the sun. Like any other villager she only visits now and then, so don’t expect her every day.
Anna has a spouse portrait. Marry her, reach 14 hearts, and the Traveling Cart will start selling a framed portrait of her for 30,000g, the same as any vanilla spouse.
Anna has a house! Through year 1 she lives with Haley. Near the Community Center there’s a construction site, and that’s where her house is being built. Once you hit year 2 it’s finished and she moves in. If you have 6+ hearts with her when year 2 arrives, a move-in event will play.
[b]Everything else in 3.0.0:[/b]
[list]
[*]Thirty new marriage lines that change depending on how the marriage is going[/*]
[*]Marriage dialogue now shifts with the season and the weather[/*]
[*]Her own lines for the Flower Dance, including as your spouse[/*]
[*]She joins the Winter Star gift exchange[/*]
[*]She can be invited to the movies, with her own taste in films and snacks[/*]
[*]She reacts to the valley changing: the Community Center, Joja, the bus, the theater, Willy’s boat[/*]
[*]First lines for having a child[/*]
[*]New lines for dating her, and for marrying someone else[/*]
[*]Her language is now consistently called Gallian[/*]
[*]Dozens of lines that were written but never played are fixed and in the game[/*]
[/list]NOTE: MAY BREAK ANNA FROM SAVES WITH PREVIOUS VERSION. IF THERE ARE ANY ISSUES IMMEDIATELY AFTER INSTALL SKIP A DAY BEFORE REPORTING.
